title: Three-shot UGC product ad workflow
purpose: Create a reusable Infiknit canvas plan for a short product ad: hook, demonstration, and payoff.

sampleInputs.audience: commuters who want coffee to stay hot through the morning
brandConstraints: no readable brand claims unless supplied by the user
referenceAssets: One product photo or existing Infiknit Product reference asset, if available

nodes.title: Shared ad brief
nodes.prompt: Vertical UGC-style ad for a matte sage 32 oz insulated tumbler. Audience: commuters who want coffee to stay hot through the morning. Keep visuals natural, handheld, and product-forward. Do not add unsupported performance claims or fake testimonials.

nodes.title: Hook still
nodes.prompt: Close handheld kitchen-counter shot: commuter reaches for the matte sage insulated tumbler next to keys and a phone, early morning light, natural product detail, no text overlays.

nodes.title: Demo still
nodes.prompt: Mid-shot of coffee being poured into the matte sage insulated tumbler on a desk, visible steam, realistic hand position, clean background, no logos unless supplied.

nodes.title: Payoff still
nodes.prompt: Commuter holding the same matte sage tumbler on a train platform, calm morning commute, product clearly visible, no text overlays.

nodes.title: Hook clip
nodes.prompt: Subtle handheld push-in as the commuter grabs the tumbler and exits frame. Keep the product shape and matte sage finish consistent.

nodes.title: Demo clip
nodes.prompt: Short realistic pour motion with gentle steam. Keep cup geometry stable and avoid adding labels or claims.

nodes.title: Payoff clip
nodes.prompt: Small natural camera sway as the commuter lifts the tumbler before boarding. Keep the same tumbler appearance.

queuePlan: Generate and inspect the three image stills first.
Only queue the video nodes after the stills match the product and composition.
Revise failed branches independently instead of regenerating the whole graph.

expectedOutputs: One saved Infiknit canvas project containing the shared Text brief, three Image nodes, three Video nodes, and six explicit connections.
Three reviewed image stills before video spend.
Up to three short vertical clips ready for separate editing, captioning, or assembly outside this MCP surface.
localConnectionLimits: Infiknit must be open on the same computer as the agent.
The MCP plugin talks to the local loopback server only; cloud-hosted agents cannot reach it directly.
Provider keys and OAuth sessions stay inside Infiknit and are not exposed to the agent.
The MCP surface can create, queue, inspect, and review canvas media; it does not provide final timeline editing, captions, or clip concatenation.
